 This one wasn't really there as seamer Jack Edwards hit a length. 
 Live by the sword, die by the sword.

 Phil Salt has been dismissed inside the opening over of the match in 23% (13/56 matches) of his T20Is as an opener.

 Eng 3-1 published at 1 overs 1 overs 
 Crikey. England haven't settled into this. 
 Twice Aneurin Donald almost sweeps into the hands of a fielder throughout the remainder of the over.
 We saw Donald make his debut at the end of the English summer. Barely anyone scores as quickly as him in T20s.

 Ah. Phil Salt, batting as he does, slams the first ball straight to mid-off. Mitch Marsh juggles the ball and ultimately takes it.
 52 367 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 08:16 GMT 08:16 GMT 
 Left-arm spinner Joel Davies is going to open up against England's hard-hitting Welsh opening pair.
 Media caption, Two Welshmen to open the batting for England?
 7 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 How are England doing in T20s? published at 08:14 GMT 08:14 GMT 
 Image source, Getty Images I'll forgive you if you've forgotten but England are on a great run in the T20 format. 
 Having gone unbeaten across the English summer, they have won seven T20s in a row since losing to India in the World Cup semi-final in March.
 It means they're top of the world rankings. Even without Jos Buttler and Jofra Archer, they start this series as big favourites.
 Priorities may be elsewhere right now but the next T20 World Cup is in Australia.
